**Fighter starting items:** Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 respectively, per `worker/src/db/seed.sql`).

**Where defined:**
- `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` constant in `worker/src/services/character.ts` maps each class to its item IDs (used at `:59` and `:65` in `createCharacter`).
- The item IDs resolve to names via the seed data in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (weapons 1–10, armor 11–16, potions 17–21, misc 22–28), inserted in autoincrement order.

Note: a known doc/code quirk (bug B-09) — the code comments label item 23 as "Rations," but it's actually "Torches" per the seed insert order.
